Record Class PubSubOption.DisableSignal

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
org.wpilib.networktables.PubSubOption.DisableSignal
Record Components:
disabled - True to disable, false to enable
All Implemented Interfaces:
PubSubOption
Enclosing interface:
PubSubOption
public static record PubSubOption.DisableSignal(boolean disabled) extends Record implements PubSubOption
For subscriptions, specify whether value updates should not signal the local subscription handle. This option defaults to disabled.
